summary.text: Lindsey Dougherty is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates, representing the 75th District, which covers part of Chesterfield County, part of Prince George County and the city of Hopewell, and has served since January 14, 2026.
Dougherty sits on the House committees on Finance; Communications, Technology and Innovation; and Education.

paragraphs.text: Lindsey Dougherty was born in Knoxville, TN, according to the House profile.
The profile lists Dougherty's education as North Carolina State University (Master of Public Administration, May 2012) and University of Tennessee, Knoxville (Bachelor of Arts, May 2006).
The profile gives Dougherty's occupation as senior research administrator.

Dougherty's listed memberships and affiliations include Director of Finance on the Board of Directors for Women of Endurance (January 2021 to present); Certified Research Administrator (May 2024 to present).
